We have mass spec data: main peak at m/z 235.13947 (intensity 100). Likely molecular ion [M+H]+? Usually ESI positive gives [M+H]+. So molecular weight ~ 234.13 (if M+H = 235.14). So neutral mass ~ 234.13 Da.

We need to propose SMILES. No other data given. We can use other spectra to narrow down. Let's get 1H NMR and 13C NMR.
